Private beach access!

Spacious, stunning condo

3 Bedrooms, 3 Baths

3 bikes!

Large balcony

Sunset Oasis on 30A by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Say hello to Sunset Oasis, your stylish home base tucked perfectly between Alys Beach and Seacrest Beach. This stylish condo with a modern coastal design has plenty of room to relax and recharge. The highlight is the incredible private beach access to the pristine Gulf waters, just a short stroll away! Professionally designed interiors keep things bright, calming, and polished. The full kitchen is ready for everything from lazy-morning waffles to a dinner-in kind of night, and the in-unit laundry means you can pack light and stay refreshed. Two guest rooms, each with a queen bed, TV, and full bath, sit on opposite sides of the foyer, giving everyone a little extra privacy. One space includes a private attached bathroom, the other offers its own ensuite setup, both with shower/tub combos for easy unwinding. Head deeper into the home for the roomy primary suite, complete with a king bed, TV, and a full bathroom featuring a separate soaking tub and walk-in shower.

It’s a quiet, comfortable retreat designed for slow mornings and relaxed evenings. The private balcony is perfect for enjoying the coastal air or catching the soft glow of sunset. And with three complimentary bikes, cruising through the restaurants, shops, and pathways of Seacrest, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach becomes part of the fun. Spontaneity is key! Private beach access? Oh my! It’s just a 6-minute walk from your door, making spontaneous trips to the sand very, very tempting. And because it’s an Oversee 30A home, your stay is supported by a local team who genuinely cares. We’re nearby, available every day and evening, and here to make sure your trip runs smoothly from beginning to end. Overview: - Private beach access just a 6-minute stroll away - Conveniently located between Alys Beach and Seacrest Beach - Private balcony - 3 bikes - Wifi - Designated parking spot Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private full bath, shower, soaker tub, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, private bathroom, shower/tub, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, ensuite bath, shower/tub, TV Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CST
